name: Ginga Rengou Sheriff KAGUYA 2 - Joushi Shuurai
original_name: 銀河連合保安官KAGUYA2 上司襲来
source:
This is the story of Galaxy Alliance Peace Officer Kaguya and a normal Earthling, Takuma. From their chance meeting to their marriage, a new enemy now appears before the two!

Kaguya's superior is tracking a monster from another planet, but what's worse is that her superior intrudes upon her and her husband's life, creating a strange love triangle.

Have they reached the end of their ignoring one for the other battle?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034881.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是银河联盟女治安官Kaguya与普通地球人Takuma的故事。从两人偶然相遇，到结为夫妻，如今又有新的敌人出现在他们面前！

Kaguya的上司正在追踪一只来自外星的怪物。更糟的是，上司闯入了她和丈夫的生活，形成了一段奇怪的三角关系。

他们互相冷落对方的争斗，终于要结束了吗？
